scan 4 rows; ct_id = id where kind='production companies'
scan 134170 rows; sequel_kw_id = id where keyword='sequel' (varlen equality via off+dat)
scan 234997 rows; cn_set bitset(234998) of ids where country_code != pl_code AND (memmem(name,'Film') OR memmem(name,'Warner'))
hashset/inline switch over {'Sweden','Germany','Swedish','German'} with length prefilter (<=7)

Need mi row with info in {Sweden,Germany,Swedish,German}; length<=7 prefilter then memcmp

filters.predicate: country_code != '[pl]' AND (name LIKE '%Film%' OR name LIKE '%Warner%')

data_structures.mi_info_set: inline switch / 4-entry varlen compare with length prefilter
data_structures.aggregation: scalar MIN reducers (3): min_cn_id (track id, materialize name at end), min_lt_id (track id, materialize at end), min_t_id (track id, materialize at end). Compare ids only when monotonic-by-id is not guaranteed; safer: compare actual varlen strings using string_view memcmp.

min_aggregation_notes: Maintain three per-thread MIN reducers over varlen string_views (memcmp lex order): producing_company from cn.name (where cn.id matched), link_type from lt.link (where lt.id matched), complete_western_sequel from t.title (where t.id matched). Merge across threads at end.

parallelism.notes: Driver cardinality is small (~hundreds-thousands). Use dynamic chunking with chunk_size ~= max(1, (hi-lo)/(threads*4)). Each thread has local MIN reducers; merge under mutex at end.
